plan.name: Strategy 3: Systematic Search with Heating and Placement
plan.strategy: Systematically search for the tomato in all possible storage locations (fridge, cabinets, countertops). Heat it if needed, and then place it in the garbagecan.
steps: Search the fridge first for the tomato, as it is a common storage location.
If the tomato is not found in the fridge, systematically search countertops and cabinets.
Heat the tomato in the microwave if it is not already hot.
Place the hot tomato into the garbagecan.
